purpose: Given a Chinese script or topic, produce a vertical narrated short video with synchronized burned-in subtitles.

environment_variables.description: Required by vcut mbaiscvip TTS. May be set in environment or project .env.

copywriting_rules: Each scene expresses exactly one idea.
headline should be short and preferably two visual lines.
body should be one compact sentence shown on screen.
narration should be natural Chinese spoken copy with clear Chinese punctuation.
Do not put usage instructions or meta commentary in visible text.

ai_execution_algorithm.action: Extract topic, audience, stance, key points, desired tone, and target length from the user's script or brief.
Convert the copy into 6 to 10 scenes. Each scene needs slug, title, headline, body, narration, accent, and visual.
Create a JSON file that conforms to workflow/scene_input.schema.json.
Run py_compile and ffprobe checks. Extract same-scene frames if subtitle refresh is in doubt.
Return the output video path and any verification notes.

render_pipeline: Split each scene narration into short subtitle display lines.
Group subtitle lines into scene-scoped vcut TTS request chunks up to 299 characters.
Generate one vcut TTS audio chunk per request group.
Trim leading silence from each request audio chunk.
Allocate subtitle line timing inside each request chunk using weighted text length.
Write ASS subtitles using estimated line timing within real request chunk durations.
Render one static scene image per scene.
Build scene frame durations from subtitle/audio chunk timestamps.
Apply video filters in this exact order: scale -> pad -> fps=30 -> subtitles.
Mux the rendered video stream with build/narration.wav.

visual_frame_generation.actual_artifact: Static 1080x1920 PNG scene cards, not a .pptx deck.

critical_invariants.subtitle_sync: A TTS request chunk may contain multiple subtitle lines; line timings are allocated within the real chunk duration using weighted estimates.
critical_invariants.tts_chunking: Default mode groups subtitle lines up to 299 chars per scene to reduce API calls.
critical_invariants.tts_backend: Default TTS backend is vcut mbaiscvip via vcut-tts-interface semantics.
critical_invariants.subtitle_refresh: The subtitles filter must run after fps=30, otherwise subtitles freeze until scene changes.
critical_invariants.text_consistency: Generated subtitle text must normalize to the same text as all scene narration.
critical_invariants.frame_rate: Final video must report avg_frame_rate as 30/1.

available_visuals.question: Opening question, contradiction, or hook.
available_visuals.calendar: Experiment, log, time period, or habit.
available_visuals.three_nodes: Three categories, three findings, or compact result.
available_visuals.five_tasks: Action list, today's tasks, immediate next step.
available_visuals.quote: Closing quote, distilled thesis, final statement.
